title: Astro Rules
summary: Project rules for Astro sites: zero-JS by default, islands with the right client directive, typed content collections and optimized images.
description: These rules teach an agent to treat Astro as a content-first framework where pages ship no JavaScript unless an island asks for it. They settle where data loads, when a framework component is justified and how images are served.
Use them to stop generated code from sprinkling client:load on everything or reaching for fetch inside components when a content collection would give typed, validated data.
useWhen: You start a new Astro site
An agent adds client:load to every component
Content lives in loose Markdown files with no schema
Lighthouse scores drop after a generated change
body:
# Project rules: Astro

## Structure
- Pages live in `src/pages`, shared layout in `src/layouts`, reusable markup in `.astro` components. Use a React, Svelte or Vue component only when it needs client state.
- Keep TypeScript strict. Extend `astro/tsconfigs/strict` and type component props with an `interface Props`.

## Islands and hydration
- Default to no client JavaScript. Choose the lightest directive: `client:visible` for below-the-fold widgets, `client:idle` for low priority, `client:only` only when SSR cannot work. Justify any `client:load` in a comment.
- Pass serializable props only. Share state between islands with a small store, not through the DOM.

## Content and data
- Put Markdown, MDX and JSON in content collections with a Zod schema in `src/content.config.ts`. Read them with `getCollection`, never by importing paths by hand.
- Fetch remote data in frontmatter at build time. Mark a route `prerender = false` only when it truly needs request data.

## Images and assets
- Use `<Image />` or `<Picture />` from `astro:assets` with width, height and alt text. Keep originals in `src`, not `public`.
- Scope styles inside the component; avoid global CSS except a tokens file.

## Before finishing
- Run `astro check`, then `astro build`. Fix every type error and broken link; do not suppress with `any`.
- Add a sitemap and a canonical URL in the shared layout.

example.prompt: Add a blog with tags and an RSS feed
example.result: The agent defines a posts collection with a schema, builds list and tag pages from getCollection, adds an RSS endpoint and runs astro check and build.

faq.question: Does this assume server rendering?
faq.answer: No. It prefers static output and only allows on-demand routes when a page needs request data.

faq.question: Can I use it with React islands?
faq.answer: Yes. The hydration rules apply to any framework component you mount inside an Astro page.

access: Instructions only; it does not read or run anything by itself
